releases.name: v0.16.1 — TUI Conversation Banner Auto-Expiry, Prompt Clear & Click-to-Dismiss
releases.body:
## What's Changed in v0.16.1

- **TUI Conversation Intervention Banner (`session.composer.top`) Lifecycle & Dismissal Fix:**
  - **TTL Auto-Expiry (`payload.duration`):** Server-side `interventionSnapshots` (`src/index.ts`) and TUI-side `storeIntervention` (`src/tui.tsx`) automatically expire and clear intervention banners after `payload.duration` (`4000ms` for warnings, `5000ms` for errors/blocks). The 500ms TUI RPC polling loop (`guardian.interventions.current`) checks `Date.now() >= entry.expiresAt` so expired banners are never resurrected.
  - **Immediate Clear on New User Prompt:** Submitting a new human prompt (`session.hook("prompt")` → `noteHumanPrompt(sessionID)`) immediately clears any previous turn's lingering intervention banner without waiting for `/guardian reset`.
  - **Click-to-Dismiss (`onMouseDown`):** Clicking `<GuardianConversationIntervention>` in `src/tui.tsx` immediately dismisses both local TUI state and the server snapshot via `guardian.interventions.clear` RPC.
- **Local vs. Global Project Scope Precedence (`isDirectoryInGuardianScope`):**
  - Evaluates `isProjectLocalPluginInstall(startupDirectory)` before `hasGlobalGuardianInstall()` so a project-local Guardian instance never supervises foreign projects even when the host machine also has a global `~/.config/opencode` configuration.
- **Verification:** **791 / 791** unit & regression tests passing, **18 / 18** sandbox scenarios, **10 / 10** live OpenCode `v2.3.2` + Bun `1.4.4` acceptance checks, Oxlint 0 warnings / 0 errors across 112 files.

releases.name: v0.16.0 — Universal V2 Plugin Mesh Bridge, External State & Local/Global Scope Isolation
releases.body:
## What's Changed in v0.16.0

- **Universal OpenCode V2 Plugin Mesh Bridge (`src/bridge.ts` v2.2.0):** Zero-dependency N-way interoperability across `opencode-guardian`, `opencode-hi`, `opencode-smart-questions`, and sibling V2 plugins via `Symbol.for("opencode.mesh.v2")` and `opencode-mesh.state` RPC.
- **Cryptographic Provenance, Session Leases & Deterministic Interventions:** Preserves `metadata["opencode-mesh"].token` in `sanitizeObject`, coordinates `user_interaction` / `active_remediation` / `orchestration_dispatch` leases, records/clears deterministic mesh interventions, and synchronizes active handoffs across Guardian, Hi, and Smart Questions.
- **External Per-Project State Directory (Zero `.opencode/` Pollution):** Stores per-project audit logs in `~/.local/state/opencode-guardian/projects/<projectHash>/guardian-events.jsonl` (`0600`) instead of `<project>/.opencode/`, preventing untracked files in git repositories and read-only `.opencode/` sandbox lockouts in `opencode-hi`. Isolates `NODE_TEST_CONTEXT` runs under `os.tmpdir()/opencode-guardian-tests-<pid>/` with automatic process-exit cleanup.
- **Local vs. Global Project Scope Isolation:** Project-local installations strictly supervise only their own project directory (and subdirectories) without interfering with unrelated projects on the shared OpenCode server; global installations (`~/.config/opencode/...`) supervise all projects while honoring per-project overrides.
- **Documentation & Verification:** Expanded `README.md` installation guide (Global, Project-Local, `.opencode/plugins/` Wrapper/Symlink, `file://`, and Remote TUI `cli.json`). Verified with **789/789** unit/regression tests, **18/18** sandbox scenarios, and **10/10** live OpenCode `v2.3.2` + Bun `1.4.4` acceptance checks.

releases.name: opencode-guardian v0.15.2
releases.body:
OpenCode v2.3.1-v2.3.2 compatibility & hardening release:

- **Evidence & Background Execution (`src/evidence.ts`, `src/index.ts`, `src/locale-intents.ts`)**: Properly handles `state.metadata.error === true`, running/timeout-to-background bash tools, `experimental.idle` session tracking, Code Mode `execute` `state.metadata.toolCalls` expansion, string/structured `output` extraction, and `synthetic`/`shell` message normalization.
- **Task Contract (`src/task-contract.ts`)**: Rejects directory reads and zero-line reads as source-review evidence.
- **Agent Capability (`src/agent-capability.ts`)**: Merges `context.agent.list()` base permissions with `session.permissions` instead of returning early.
- **Secret Sanitization (`src/secrets/patterns.ts`, `src/secrets/sanitizer.ts`)**: Prevents false-positive redaction of `pass` counters and preserves falsy primitives (`null`, `undefined`, `boolean`, `number`, `""`) in object properties.
- **Verification**: 781/781 unit tests, strict TypeScript & oxlint (0 warnings/errors), 18/18 sandbox tests, and 10/10 live OpenCode v2.3.2 acceptance tests.

releases.name: v0.15.0 — Pure OpenCode v2.3.0 Architecture (End of V1 Support)
releases.body:
## Breaking Changes
- **End of OpenCode V1 Support:** Removed OpenCode V1 (`1.x` / `@opencode-ai/plugin` / `./server` / `sidebar_content` / V1 idle fallback) support. Users on OpenCode 1.x should pin `opencode-guardian@0.14.0`.
- **Pure OpenCode V2 (`>=2.3.0`) & OpenTUI (`>=0.8.4`) Alignment:** Updated `peerDependencies` floors to `@opencode/plugin >=2.3.0`, `@opentui/core >=0.8.4`, `@opentui/solid >=0.8.4`, and `solid-js >=1.9.0` with zero runtime dependencies.

## What's New
- **Typed `./rpc` Export (`dist/intervention-rpc.js`):** Exposes `guardian.interventions.get` and `guardian.interventions.clear` via `Rpc.define` (`@opencode/plugin/rpc`) with `sessionID` `maxLength: 256` validation and project-directory-scoped `{}` clearing.
- **`shell.hook("create.before")` Preflight Boundary:** Enforces preflight checks at shell creation alongside `tool.hook("execute.before")` with LIFO hook rollback on setup failure.
- **`session.fork` & Background Subagent Isolation:** Treats `session.fork` / `session.forked` as independent root sessions, honors top-level `location.directory`, and isolates `background === true` subagents in `execute.after` so sibling background subagents are never starved.
- **Security & Sanitizer Hardening:** Preserves `Uint8Array` / `ArrayBuffer` views and non-plain object prototypes (`Message` class) in `sanitizeObject` / `sanitizeMessages`; inspects multi-stage commands via `splitShellStages`; fixes `task/completion-gate` `"in progress"` false-verified guard; preserves both `editIntegrity` and `fingerprint` in `VerificationSnapshotStore`; re-verifies `verifiedStateDirs` via `lstatSync`.
- **TUI Bun `1.4.4` Adaptive Fallback & RPC Race Fixes:** Fixed `dist/tui.js` fallback to `./tui-standalone.js` in Bun `1.4.4` without `ResolveMessage` crashes, fixed `GuardianSidebar` reactive `props.sessionID` updates, subscribed to `session.moved`, and added per-session generation gating for 500ms RPC polls.

## Verification
- **Unit & Regression Suite:** 765 / 765 PASS (`npm test`)
- **Sandbox Scenarios:** 18 / 18 PASS (`node sandbox/comprehensive-test.mjs`)
- **Security Benchmark:** 17 / 17 PASS (`tests/security-benchmark.test.mjs`)
- **Live OpenCode v2.3.0 + Bun 1.4.4 + Packed `.tgz` Acceptance:** 10 / 10 PASS (`node sandbox/v2-live-acceptance.mjs`)
